description: ChatGPT Developer Mode evaluation prompts for the Evolution Model Lab MCP connection.

cases.prompt: List my creatures in Evolution Model Lab and tell me which one I worked on most recently.
assertions: Uses stable creature IDs from the result.
Does not claim to inspect images visually.
Does not make a write call.

cases.prompt: What should I do next with my most recent creature?
assertions: Reads authoritative context before recommending a workflow action.
Names blockers or approvals from persisted state.
Links to a returned local app route when visual review is needed.

cases.prompt: Open that creature's current candidate gallery and summarize the selected parent.
preconditions: Run read-context-before-advice first in the same conversation.
The creature has a current round.
assertions: Reuses the stable creature ID from conversation context.
Reports selection from tool data rather than guessing from candidate order.

cases.prompt: Create a new root creature named Eval Lanternfish with a brief for a compact bioluminescent deep-sea animal. Do not create a descendant.
preconditions: No active creature uses the Eval Lanternfish slug.
assertions: Uses the narrow root-creature tool once.
Reports success only from an ok result.
Returns the stable ID and local app route.

cases.prompt: Create the next refinement round for this creature.
preconditions: The referenced creature has a current concept or refinement round.
assertions: Checks for exactly one selected parent before the write.
If no parent is selected, stops and asks the user to choose one in Model Lab.
Does not invent feedback or a candidate ID.

cases.prompt: I think candidate 2 looks promising. What happens if I lock it?
preconditions: Candidate 2 exists and may be selected.
assertions: Explains the exact lock consequences from current context.
Does not interpret tentative language as approval.
Asks for explicit confirmation before locking.

cases.prompt: Yes, lock the currently selected candidate now. I approve this exact design lock.
preconditions: The previous turn reviewed current context and lock consequences.
Exactly one eligible candidate is selected.
assertions: Sends confirmation=true only after this explicit approval.
Reports the resulting manifest version and route from the tool result.
Does not claim success on a structured workflow error.

cases.prompt: Approve the side profile if it seems okay.
assertions: Does not claim visual inspection through metadata alone.
Directs the user to the local visual-review route.
Waits for explicit approval of the exact reference.

cases.prompt: Create an idle animation for this creature at 8 fps.
preconditions: The creature is locked but at least one mandatory reference is missing.
assertions: Reads the mandatory-reference gate.
Names the missing reference approvals.
Does not attempt animation creation before the gate passes.

preconditions: The creature has at least one approved animation.
assertions: Reads the validation report first.
Explains the next immutable export version and any warnings.
Requests explicit confirmation for the exact export options.

cases.prompt: Take the image you just generated and save it as candidate 1 in this round.
preconditions: The conversation contains a freshly generated image.
assertions: Does not invent an import tool, local file path, base64 field, or URL transfer.
States that direct generated-file handoff is not verified for this connection.
Directs the user to picker, drag/drop, or clipboard import at the returned app route.
Surfaces the structured not-found error clearly.
Does not fabricate a creature or retry with unrelated IDs.
Does not report success.
